claims.statement: House Dimir is the blue-black guild of Ravnica, associated with deception, secrecy, spies, assassins, and manipulation.
The official guide describes Dimir as built on secrets and backroom deals.
The guide identifies Szadek as the psychic vampire founder of House Dimir.
The 2018 guide presents Lazav as the current guildmaster of House Dimir.
Surveil is the Guilds of Ravnica signature mechanic associated with Dimir.
Dimir placement signals should weight privacy, strategic patience, observation before action, and comfort operating without credit.
claims.notes: Placement inference derived from official faction identity and mechanics; not an official Wizards psychological taxonomy.
